text:
Anya K.: FYI CI run for quant experiment q4_8 v1->q4_8 failed and left the eval-runner queues clogged. Seeing retry spikes and metric ingestion lag.
Jiro T.: Link?
Anya K.: https://ci.redwood/runs/3321 — failure in step `eval-runner/dispatch`
Sam R.: Can you paste logs from the pod?
Anya K.: kubectl -n eval logs pod/runner-abc-12 --tail 200\```
2025-11-02T14:03:12Z ERROR DispatchError partition=partition-12 reason=queue_overflow
2025-11-02T14:03:12Z WARN  WorkerRetry id=wr-332 delay_ms=100
2025-11-02T14:03:13Z INFO  QueueSize partition-12 size=1024
2025-11-02T14:03:14Z ERROR MetricIngest failed key=completion_abc reason=duplicate_id
```
Lee P.: That pattern smells like an assignment imbalance — partition-12 got a ton of long-sequence examples. We recently changed splitter -> hash(example_id). Could be a collision hotspot.
Maria G.: Also saw the quant run produce a ~0.7 BLEU drop when compared to float baseline in the dashboard; maybe retries are re-sending prefixes and warmups are inconsistent for q4_8.
eval-ci: eval-ci: job 3321 finished: checks failing: runner-backpressure, metric-ingestion-lag
ops-bot: ops-bot increased eval-runner max_workers from 30 -> 50 for the canary to relieve pressure
Sam R.: Note that PR #412 bumped retry backoff base 50ms -> 100ms and max_attempts 8 -> 12. That config can amplify stampedes when many workers backoff similarly.
Jiro T.: @Anya can you capture the metric ingestion error lines? We need to know if dedupe key includes partition id. If not, reassignments could double-emit completions.
Anya K.: paste: `metric_ingest: duplicate_id=abc123 count=7` — duplicates correlate with partition flip events in the logs.
Lee P.: I'll spin a local harness with partition-proxy and run a synthetic long-seq load to reproduce. If splitter hash is the culprit, we can switch to mod-by-shard-size or add jitter.
Maria G.: For the quality side: q4_8's KV-cache warmup is slower on long contexts; if retries re-send earlier tokens we might be priming cache differently across attempts -> eval mismatch. Worth isolating the two issues.
Sam R.: Plan: 1) revert/patch backoff to avoid synchronized retries, 2) make dedupe key partition-aware (or use global monotonic ids), 3) reproduce locally with long-seq harness, 4) re-run CI after canary.
Anya K.: I'll open a tracking ticket and assign owners: revert backoff -> @Sam, dedupe key -> @Jiro, harness -> @Lee, quant/quality analysis -> @Maria.
Jiro T.: Quick note — add a guard to metric ingestion to ignore duplicates within 1s window to reduce noise while we patch.
ops-bot: ops-bot: created incident INC-2025-78 to track backpressure/dedup issue
Anya K.: thanks all. I'll attach the failing CI logs and the minimal reproduction steps in the ticket. :eyes:
